svg.title: Right hand, palmar view: carpals, metacarpals, phalanges
svg.desc: Right hand from the palm side, thumb at the viewer's left. Proximal carpal row (radial to ulnar): scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum with the pisiform on its palmar surface. Distal row: trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate with its hook. The thumb has 2 phalanges; the other digits have 3.
